options.content:
### Industrial Protocol Trace & Topology Explorer
Select a **$session** above to view live device-to-device topology (`v_grafana_node_graph_nodes` / `v_grafana_node_graph_edges`) and inspect Tempo-style span waterfalls (`v_grafana_traces`).
> **Virtual-Clock Note:** Adjust Grafana's time range picker to match the PCAP capture timestamps, then click any `trace_id` in the **Trace & Span Explorer** table (or drill down from the main Analyzer dashboard) to load its full span waterfall, attributes, timeline logs, and correlated `tag_values` / `captured_command_events`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id,
  title,
  "subTitle",
  "mainStat",
  "secondaryStat",
  arc__success,
  arc__error
FROM v_grafana_node_graph_nodes
WHERE session_id = '$session';

SELECT
  id,
  source,
  target,
  "mainStat",
  "secondaryStat",
  detail__protocol,
  detail__span_count,
  detail__error_count,
  detail__avg_duration_ms,
  detail__p95_duration_ms
FROM v_grafana_node_graph_edges
WHERE session_id = '$session';

WITH filtered_spans AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    s.device_pair_id,
    s.start_time,
    s.trace_id,
    s.span_id,
    s.parent_span_id,
    s.service_name,
    s.operation_name,
    s.origin_kind,
    s.status_code,
    s.status_message,
    s.duration_ms,
    s.protocol,
    s.request_frame_number,
    s.response_frame_number
  FROM trace_spans s
  WHERE s.session_id = '$session'
    AND s.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
    AND s.protocol IN ($protocol)
    AND s.status_code IN ($status)
    AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
),
trace_counts AS (
  SELECT
    trace_id,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS span_count
  FROM trace_spans
  WHERE session_id = '$session'
  GROUP BY trace_id
),
ranked_traces AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    tc.span_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.trace_id
      ORDER BY (f.parent_span_id IS NOT NULL) ASC, f.start_time ASC, f.span_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM filtered_spans f
  JOIN trace_counts tc ON tc.trace_id = f.trace_id
)
SELECT
  to_char(r.start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Start Time",
  r.trace_id AS "trace_id",
  r.protocol AS "Protocol",
  dp.name AS "Device Pair",
  r.service_name AS "Service",
  r.operation_name AS "Operation",
  r.origin_kind AS "Origin",
  r.status_code AS "Status",
  COALESCE(r.status_message, '') AS "Status Message",
  ROUND(r.duration_ms::numeric, 2) AS "Duration (ms)",
  r.span_count AS "Spans",
  r.request_frame_number AS "Req Frame",
  r.response_frame_number AS "Resp Frame"
FROM ranked_traces r
JOIN device_pairs dp ON dp.id = r.device_pair_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.start_time DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  "traceID",
  "spanID",
  "parentSpanID",
  "operationName",
  "serviceName",
  "startTime",
  "duration",
  "statusCode",
  "statusMessage",
  "serviceTags",
  "tags",
  "logs"
FROM v_grafana_traces
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND "traceID" = COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM('$trace_id'), ''),
    (SELECT trace_id FROM trace_spans WHERE session_id = '$session' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
  )
ORDER BY "startTime" ASC;

SELECT
  tv.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(tv.packet_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Packet Time",
  to_char(tv.event_timestamp, 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "RTU Event Time",
  td.tag_name AS "Tag Name",
  td.protocol_address AS "Address",
  COALESCE(tv.scaled_numeric_value::text, tv.boolean_value::text, tv.raw_hex) AS "Value",
  td.engineering_units AS "Units",
  COALESCE(tv.quality_flags, 'NORMAL') AS "Quality Flags",
  tv.is_value_change AS "Changed",
  tv.span_id AS "Span ID"
FROM tag_values tv
JOIN tag_definitions td ON tv.tag_id = td.id
WHERE tv.session_id = '$session'
  AND tv.trace_id = COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM('$trace_id'), ''),
    (SELECT trace_id FROM trace_spans WHERE session_id = '$session' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
  )
ORDER BY tv.packet_timestamp ASC, tv.frame_number ASC
LIMIT 250;

SELECT
  c.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(c.timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Timestamp",
  dp.name AS "Device Pair",
  c.protocol AS "Protocol",
  c.command_type AS "Command Type",
  c.target_address AS "Target Address",
  COALESCE(c.control_action, '-') AS "Action",
  c.command_count AS "Count",
  c.pulse_on_ms AS "Pulse On (ms)",
  c.pulse_off_ms AS "Pulse Off (ms)",
  c.unscaled_command_value AS "Value",
  '0x' || encode(c.raw_pdu_bytes, 'hex') AS "Raw PDU Hex",
  c.span_id AS "Span ID"
FROM captured_command_events c
JOIN device_pairs dp ON c.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE c.session_id = '$session'
  AND c.trace_id = COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM('$trace_id'), ''),
    (SELECT trace_id FROM trace_spans WHERE session_id = '$session' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
  )
ORDER BY c.timestamp ASC, c.frame_number ASC
LIMIT 250;

SELECT
  md5(session_id::text || ':' || time_bucket(INTERVAL '$window_bucket', start_time_utc)::text) AS "traceID",
  "spanID",
  "parentSpanID",
  "operationName",
  "serviceName",
  "startTime",
  "duration",
  "statusCode",
  "statusMessage",
  "serviceTags",
  "tags",
  "logs"
FROM v_grafana_traces
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND protocol IN ($protocol)
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time_utc)
ORDER BY "startTime" ASC
LIMIT 250;
